name: Rula
one_liner: Flat per-session pay ($70-90) with e-prescribing for prescribers, fast credentialing, and weekly payments across all 50 states.
short_description: Rula (formerly Path Mental Health) offers flat per-session rates for therapists and psychiatrists, with e-prescribing capabilities and weekly direct deposit payments.
long_description: Rula (formerly Path Mental Health) is a virtual mental health provider network operating in all 50 states. Unlike revenue-sharing platforms, Rula offers flat per-session rates ranging from $70-90 depending on state and credentials, with prescribers typically earning higher rates. The platform handles credentialing, billing, and patient matching. Rula supports both therapists and psychiatric prescribers with integrated e-prescribing for controlled and non-controlled medications—a key differentiator from therapy-only platforms. Providers work as 1099 independent contractors with flexible scheduling and receive weekly direct deposit payments. Rula is in-network with major insurers including Optum, Cigna, Aetna, Anthem, and various Blue Cross Blue Shield plans. The platform provides steady client referrals through its matching system, though providers report that salary increases have been halted since 2024.
best_for: Therapists wanting predictable flat per-session pay (vs. variable revenue sharing)
Psychiatric prescribers (PMHNPs, psychiatrists) who need integrated e-prescribing
Clinicians seeking weekly direct deposit payments
Providers who prefer knowing exactly what they'll earn per session
Those wanting turnkey insurance billing without admin burden
not_for: Clinicians building their own independent practice (credentials belong to Rula)
Therapists wanting to maximize per-session earnings (direct credentialing pays more)
Those expecting regular rate increases (raises halted since 2024)
Providers wanting control over payer contract negotiations
Clinicians who may want portable credentials when leaving

pricing.notes: Free to join with flat per-session rates. No membership fees. Rula pays fixed amounts per session rather than revenue sharing. Rates vary by state and credentials.

reimbursement_rates.therapist_range: $70-90 per session depending on state and credentials
reimbursement_rates.prescriber_range: Higher rates for psychiatric prescribers (PMHNPs, MDs)
reimbursement_rates.notes: Unlike Headway/Grow/Alma which take a cut of insurance reimbursements, Rula pays flat rates regardless of what insurers actually pay. PMHNP rates are notably competitive.

pay_fairness.notes: Flat $70-90/session is predictable but rates frozen since 2024

credential_portability.notes: Credentials stay with Rula. Must re-credential if you leave

compensation_transparency.notes: Flat $70-90/session rates clearly stated upfront. Know exactly what you'll earn

rate_stability.notes: Rates frozen (not cut) since 2024—stable but stagnant

fairness_rating.methodology: HeyPsych Fairness Rating v1.0: Weighted score across pay fairness (30%), credential portability (20%), compensation transparency (15%), rate stability (15%), clinician-founded (10%), payment speed (5%), and benefits (5%). Scale: A (80-100), B (65-79), C (50-64), D (35-49), F (<35).

credential_portability.issue: Credentials belong to Rula, not you
credential_portability.impact: If you leave, you lose panel access and must re-credential independently
credential_portability.mitigation: Consider dual-credentialing if planning eventual independent practice

rate_freeze.impact: Don't expect regular pay increases on the platform
rate_freeze.context: Many therapy platforms have frozen or reduced rates amid market changes

flat_rate_tradeoff.upside: You know exactly what you'll earn per session—no surprises
flat_rate_tradeoff.downside: If insurers pay Rula more, you don't benefit from the upside
flat_rate_tradeoff.comparison: Revenue-sharing platforms pass through higher rates but also take a cut

prescriber_focus.benefit: E-prescribing support makes Rula good for prescribers
prescriber_focus.note: Therapy-only providers may find other platforms have stronger therapy features

seo.title: Rula: Flat Per-Session Pay for Therapists & Psychiatrists
seo.meta_description: Rula (formerly Path Mental Health) offers flat $70-90/session rates for therapists and e-prescribing for psychiatrists. Weekly payments, all 50 states.

faqs.q: How much does Rula pay therapists?
faqs.a: Rula pays flat per-session rates ranging from $70-90 depending on your state and credentials. Unlike revenue-sharing platforms, you know exactly what you'll earn. However, rate increases have been halted since 2024.

Yes, Rula has integrated e-prescribing for psychiatric prescribers (psychiatrists, PMHNPs), including controlled substances where state law permits. This is a key differentiator from therapy-only platforms.

faqs.q: How does Rula compare to Headway or Grow Therapy?
faqs.a: Rula pays flat per-session rates ($70-90) while Headway and Grow use revenue sharing. With flat rates, you know exactly what you'll earn but don't benefit if insurers pay more. Rula uniquely supports prescribers with e-prescribing. All require giving up credential portability.

faqs.q: What happens if I leave Rula?
faqs.a: Your insurance credentials stay with Rula. You'd need to re-credential independently (60-120 days). This is the same credential lock-in as Headway, Grow, and Alma.
Yes, there are no membership fees. Rula pays you flat rates per session and handles all billing. The tradeoff is you don't control contract negotiations and rates have been frozen since 2024.

funding.context: Smaller valuation than Headway/Alma, but offers flat per-session rates rather than revenue sharing

company_info.notes: Rebranded from Path Mental Health to Rula. Tech-founded, not clinician-led. Operates in all 50 states with focus on both therapy and psychiatric prescribing.
